title: The Son River changes color, and the park does not name the month
summary: Phong Nha-Ke Bang says the Son River runs jade-green in the dry season and reddish in the rainy season. It does not name those months. Which clock the cave uses, summer or winter, is check on arrival.
when: The months for each water color are check on arrival.
photoAlt: The mouth of Phong Nha Cave on green water
body: The color of the boat ride is a season fact, not a promise for this week. The national park’s cave page describes dry-season water on the Son River as jade-green and rainy-season water as reddish. It does not say which months are which. If someone told you October is one or the other, that line is not on the park page.

The same page prints two opening clocks, a summer one and a winter one, and it does not say which months use which clock. Chay River and Dark Cave may close in heavy rain, flooding, or storms. Check the board at the park before you promise a boat.
